title: MPB‑GraphFWPCA (override): λ=0.605, δ=0.10 (kd=21, k=48)
abstract: kdensity neighbor probe below 22 at the current best λ=0.605, δ=0.10, k=48. Tests whether kd=21 slightly improves the 0.7444 result observed at kd=22.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage')
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    print("[override] lam=0.605, delta=0.10, kd=21, k=48")
    return eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.10,
        kdensity=21,
        k_total=48
    )
